proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature.catalog_ref_stat_block
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item spawned-creature family requires an inline CreatureStatBlock, but this item summons a named monster stat block from the external catalog.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental

proposed_widenings.name: activated_ability.environmental_activation_predicate
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation is gated by a non-equipment physical precondition. Current activation conditions only model equipment state, not contact with terrain.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While touching this 5-pound stone to the ground, you can take a Magic action

proposed_widenings.name: CreatureDismissal.manualDismiss = bonus_action
proposed_widenings.justification: Companion dismissal currently supports magic-action or never, but this item dismisses the summoned creature with a Bonus Action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action

notes: Existing magic-item spawned_creature is close: activation cost, dawn reset, 30-foot appearance, shared initiative count, immediate-after-caster turn order, and disappearance timing all fit. I did not author a placeholder because the Earth Elemental stat block is the core payload and the current surface cannot represent it honestly without an inline fake.
